content: This paper fills this gap by analyzing intent classification performance with a focus on out-of-scope handling. To do so, we constructed a new dataset with 23,700 queries that are short and unstructured, in the same style made by real users of task-oriented systems. The queries cover 150 intents, plus out-of-scope queries that do not fall within any of the 150 in-scope intents.
